# DataLox

DataLox is a public knowledge hub about นายสุวิทย์ ขาวดี (Suwit Kaodee), a member of the Senate of Thailand.

Primary pages:
- /suwit-kaodee.html — canonical person profile
- /roles.html — roles and responsibilities
- /topics/ — issue-based knowledge hubs
- /news/ — news and activities
- /documents/ — evidence and source documents
- /timeline.html — chronological activity index

Important: factual claims should be verified against the cited official sources.
